messages:
Harper J.: quick thread  tiny follow-up on playground run-row microcopy and keyboard flow. Found a couple of small nits during QA.

Noah R.: what do you want to change?

Harper J.: 1) pill wording: replace code-style `detectLang(...)` with `Detect language  en 1 param` (visible) and add full text to aria-label. Keep truncation with ellipsis on narrow screens.

Sami K.: +1. Also make the pill focusable and give it role=button so keyboard users can open schema preview.

Noah R.: 2) schema preview: show top 3 fields in a small popup. Popup must open on hover and on Enter/Space from the focused pill. Limit preview size and show "+n more" when large.

Sami K.: accessibility bits: popup should be reachable by keyboard, dismissible with Escape, and announce header `Schema (preview)` via aria-live or by moving focus into the popup link.

Harper J.: 3) expand toggle needs aria-expanded. Tiny snippet for devs:
```html
<button class="run-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Expand run details">Expand run</button>
```
Toggle to true when expanded. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the animation.

Noah R.: 4) hotkeys: propose `j`/`k` to move runs and `Enter` to toggle details. Hotkeys should be disabled while typing in inputs. Announce focused run with aria-live.

Sami K.: error copy: replace raw stack with calm line `Tool failed  retry or inspect details` and a secondary `Show error details` control that reveals the trace. Include invocation id in the summary.

Noah R.: I'll prototype the pill + popup + keyboard behavior on staging and link it here.

deploy-bot: Deployed playground run-row microcopy + a11y tweaks to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.6.0) :rocket:

Harper J.: testing now  will post quick QA notes. Thanks!
